描述_EN: numbers of small bronze animal models such as this were both made as trinkets and for a more useful purpose, such as serving as a scroll or paperweight. modelled in the round, its paws and tail are reproduced in every detail underneath. this little buddhist lion is full of charm. in this way they are comparable to jade figures, and indeed this example is very similar to jade carvings.
描述_ZN: 像这样的小型青铜动物模型，既可以作为饰品，也可以作为更有用的用途，如作为卷轴或镇纸。 造型为圆形，它的爪子和尾巴下面的每一个细节都被再现。 这个小佛教狮子充满了魅力。 这样一来，它们就可以和玉石人物相提并论了，而且这个例子确实和玉石雕刻非常相似。
